title: Hearing on micromobility rules for e-bikes, scooters and delivery workers
summary: The Council's Transportation and Infrastructure, Consumer and Worker Protection, and Public Safety Committees held a joint hearing on September 30, 2026 examining regulation, accountability and safety issues around e-bikes, e-scooters, mopeds and delivery services in New York City. The hearing covered roughly two dozen bills, including proposals to ban class 3 e-bikes, require moped registration and retailer disclosures, mandate delivery data retention and safety reporting, create a bike trade-in program, and require third-party delivery services to carry insurance and track unsafe driving. It also included two resolutions urging state lawmakers to pass commercial e-bike licensing and stiffer penalties for hit-and-run e-scooter and e-bike incidents.
